title: unconditional love
style: new puppy coming home to his forever family. percussion, big brass band, nicaraguense.
lyrics:
compleatly dependant 
patiently waiting

watching from above
only unconditional love

bursting to show it.
tail in hyper speed

he choses his person
his life long companion

he chose with care,
knows we'll always be there

pet shop days, 
leave them behind.

its time to take a taste,
of a brand new space

 McIvors Mansion life
 you and ashley up to strife

with love....
on this is special day

welcome home!
....your new forever family
